findings.finding: The delayed-mood test needed the exact argument reference in the delivered question, not only in commentary.
findings.repair: Put the adapted question in the dialogue artifact itself and require stored literal rendered wording, source answer and scene before asking.

findings.finding: The rich bodily-reaction answer already resolved duration and exhaustion but did not resolve usefulness outside exhaustion.
findings.repair: Ask only about usefulness outside the reported condition when that distinction remains important; do not repeat a generic whole-facet question.
